Public Function OfPieProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal splitKind As Long, ByVal splitValue As Double, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object, group As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    If explicitLabels Then
        n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    stage = "group"
    Set group = target.ChartGroups(1)
    If splitKind <> 0 Then
        stage = "split-type"
        group.SplitType = splitKind

    stage = "read"
    OfPieProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    OfPieProbe = OfPieProbe & "|split=" & CStr(group.SplitType) & ":" & CStr(group.SplitValue)

Public Function BubbleProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal inputValues As Variant, ByVal explicitLabels As Boolean, ByVal inputSizes As Variant, ByVal sizesKind As Long, ByVal typeAfterData As Boolean, ByVal embedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object, item As Object
    Dim labels As Variant, i As Long, n As Long, stage As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    stage = "target"
    If embedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    If Not typeAfterData Then target.ChartType = kind
    Set item = target.SeriesCollection.NewSeries
    item.Name = "Revenue"
    stage = "values"
    item.Values = inputValues
    n = UBound(inputValues) - LBound(inputValues) + 1
    If explicitLabels Then
        ReDim labels(0 To n - 1)
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            labels(i) = CStr(i + 1)
        Next
        item.XValues = labels
    End If
    If typeAfterData Then
        stage = "type-after"
        target.ChartType = kind
    End If
    If sizesKind = 1 Then
        stage = "sizes-literal"
        item.BubbleSizes = inputSizes
    ElseIf sizesKind = 2 Then
        stage = "sizes-range"
        For i = 0 To n - 1
            Ledger.Cells(i + 1, 3).Value2 = inputSizes(LBound(inputSizes) + i)
        Next
        item.BubbleSizes = Ledger.Range(Ledger.Cells(1, 3), Ledger.Cells(n, 3))
    End If
    stage = "read"
    BubbleProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)
    BubbleProbe = BubbleProbe & "|sizes=" & CStr(VarType(item.BubbleSizes)) & ":" & CStr(item.BubbleSizes)

Public Function CaseProbe(ByVal kind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String
    Dim target As Object, anchor As Object
    On Error GoTo Failed
    If kind = 0 Then
        CaseProbe = "oxi-uniform-chart-20261106-v2"
        Exit Function
    End If
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else
        Set target = PlotHost
    End If
    Select Case kind
    Case 1
        ' Observe the original chart or the newly created embedded chart.
    Case 2
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 3
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = "Revenue"
        target.HasLegend = False
    Case 4
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ""
    Case 5
        target.HasTitle = False
        target.HasTitle = True
    Case 6
        target.HasTitle = False
    Case 7
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4131
    Case 8
        target.HasLegend = True
        target.Legend.Position = -4107
    Case 9
        target.HasLegend = False
        target.HasLegend = True
    Case 10
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Text = ChrW(&H58F2) & ChrW(&H4E0A) & " & <" & ChrW(&H96C6) & ChrW(&H8A08) & ">" & vbLf & "2026"
    Case 11
        target.HasTitle = True
        target.ChartTitle.Caption = "Caption"
    Case 12
        target.ChartType = 51
    Case Else
        Err.Raise 5, "UniformChart", "Unknown case"
    End Select
    CaseProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|objects=" & CStr(Ledger.ChartObjects.Count)
    Exit Function

Private Function TypedValues(ByVal value As Variant) As String
    Dim index As Long, result As String
    result = CStr(VarType(value)) & ":" & TypeName(value)
    If IsArray(value) Then
        result = result & "[" & CStr(LBound(value)) & "," & CStr(UBound(value)) & "]"
        For index = LBound(value) To UBound(value)
            result = result & "{" & CStr(VarType(value(index))) & ":" & CStr(value(index)) & "}"
        Next index
    Else
        result = result & ":" & CStr(value)
    End If
    TypedValues = result
End Function

Private Function DescribeSeries(ByVal target As Object) As String
    Dim index As Long, item As Object, result As String
    result = CStr(target.SeriesCollection.Count)
    For index = 1 To target.SeriesCollection.Count
        Set item = target.SeriesCollection(index)
        result = result & "|series=" & item.Name & ":" & item.Formula
        result = result & "|values=" & TypedValues(item.Values) & "|xs=" & TypedValues(item.XValues)
    Next index
    DescribeSeries = result
End Function

Public Function ChartTypeProbe(ByVal chartType As Long, ByVal sourceKind As Long, ByVal useEmbedded As Boolean) As String

    On Error GoTo Failed
    If useEmbedded Then
        Set anchor = Ledger.ChartObjects.Add(20, 30, 240, 160)
        anchor.Name = "UniformEmbedded"
        Set target = anchor.Chart
    Else

    If sourceKind = 1 Then

        item.Values = Array(1.25, 2.5, 3.75)

        Ledger.Range("B2").Value2 = 1.25
        Ledger.Range("B3").Value2 = 2.5

        target.SetSourceData Ledger.Range("A1:B4")
    End If
    ChartTypeProbe = "ok|" & Describe(target) & "|data=" & DescribeSeries(target)

   values(i) = i + 1

  item.Values = values
